{
  "to": ["Gabriel Fontes", "Sylvia Nakamura"],
  "subject": "Quick gut check on a fourth location?",
  "body": "Hey Gabriel, Sylvia —

Hope you’re both doing well. We’re seriously weighing a fourth spot, and before I get too far down the road, I’d love a gut check from you two. Not a full analysis yet — just your honest read on whether this makes sense for us right now.

We’re looking at a lease in the Pearl District, roughly 4,200 square feet, with a build-out that’s manageable if we move fast. The numbers look okay on paper, but something’s telling me to slow down and think about our bandwidth. You know me — I’d rather hear it straight now than wish I had later.

Can we grab 20 minutes sometime this week? I can work around your schedules. Just want your real thoughts, not the polished version.

Thanks, as always. — Marco

P.S. If either of you sees a red flag I’m missing, don’t wait for the call — shoot me a text."
